title: Moving an instruction to the prompt hook, logged in the plan's own words

concepts.description: An instruction given to a model far ahead of the moment it applies is followed less than the same instruction placed next to the decision it governs.
concepts.context: Task 6 of the plan moves the DELEGATE line from the SessionStart block to UserPromptSubmit, because the brief found it was followed zero times in eleven sessions

concepts.description: Text a Claude Code hook prints on SessionStart or UserPromptSubmit is added to the model's context, so a hook can steer the model without the user typing anything.
concepts.context: per the brief, the island now re-says the delegation contract next to each task-sized prompt instead of relying on the session-start block
